description: Wezowa Panna, the daughter of the god Veles, a pale green-skinned woman from the waist up with long dark green hair and a small golden crown, from the waist down a long coiling emerald snake tail, snake eyes, fangs bared, holding a small glowing flask of water, eerie and menacing, full body, three-quarter view, the figure alone, no water, no ground, no background, the whole figure inside the picture
